name: Playful
mood: sunlit paper notebook with hot-pink highlighter
summary: A warm cream product style with Hot Magenta as the only accent, Inter-only typography, heavy italic display headlines, 44px soft cards, 99px pill controls, deep card-only shadows, and illustration-led app tiles.
dos: Use Oat Canvas as the page background.
Reserve Hot Magenta for primary action, logo, links, and small accents.
Set display headlines in heavy italic Inter.
Apply shadows only to cards and app tiles.
Use illustration-led app tiles instead of photography.
donts: Do not use upright bold display headlines.
Do not introduce additional accent colors.
Do not use pure white as the full-page background.
Do not use sharp 0px to 4px radii for cards or buttons.
Do not place white cards directly on white.
Do not use shadows on text, buttons, icons, or inputs.
